def VTask.comk {α : Type u_1} (p : Set α → Prop) (he : p ∅) 
    (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) 
    (hunion : ∀ (s t : Set α), p s → p t → p (s ∪ t)) : Filter α :=
  Filter.mk { s | p sᶜ } 
    he
    (fun s t h hst => hmono sᶜ h tᶜ (Set.compl_subset_compl hst))
    (fun s t hs ht => hunion sᶜ tᶜ hs ht)
